values.description: Origin header sent with customer requests — must match FRONTEND_URL / TRUSTED_ORIGINS on the server

Phone number used for Sign-Up (Phone OTP) and Sign-In (Phone OTP). Must be a valid Indian number: 10 digits bare (9876543210) or with +91 prefix (+919876543210). Change between runs if you want a fresh account.
Email used for Sign-In (Email OTP). Must already be attached to an existing user in the database.
New email address used for the Change Email flow.
Paste the OTP here after copying it from the server console log. Used by Phone OTP verify, Email OTP sign-in, and email verification requests.
Auto-set by the Verify OTP (creates account) test script. Used by Sign-In requests to assert the same user is returned.
Product variant ID for Cart tests. Get a valid ID from the admin product list.
Product ID for Wishlist tests. Get a valid ID from the admin product list.
Customer delivery address _id (from customer profile) used for creating payment orders
Razorpay payment ID used by payment verification and reconciliation requests
Order ID returned after creating a payment order
Razorpay order ID returned after creating a payment order
Review _id for customer review update and delete endpoints
ImageKit URL of uploaded customer image
